## Hearty congratulations to Mr. K. Bharat Reddy (Alumnus, 2014 graduate MMT, MGIT) on being conferred with the INAE Young Engineer Award-2025

News Date : 02 Jan 2026News ReportThe Department of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, MGIT is delighted to congratulate Mr. K. Bharat Reddy, Alumnus, MMT, MGIT on being conferred with INAE Young Engineer Award-2025.Mr. K. Bharat Reddy graduated from the Department of Metallurgy and Material Technology, MGIT in 2014.The Staff and students of the Department convey their best wishes for his success in his future endeavours.

The Department of Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, MGIT is delighted to congratulate Mr. K. Bharat Reddy, Alumnus, MMT, MGIT on being conferred with INAE Young Engineer Award-2025.Mr. K. Bharat Reddy graduated from the Department of Metallurgy and Material Technology, MGIT in 2014.The Staff and students of the Department convey their best wishes for his success in his future endeavours.
